subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

Renegade
solution:
The correct answer is **'Follower'. **

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• The meaning of the word **'Renegade'** is a traitor or a person who betrays another person or organization.
 
• The meaning if the word **'Follower'** is an admirer or supporter of a person or set of ideas.
 
• Hence, the correct antonym for the word **'Renegade'** is **'Follower'**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let us look at the meanings of other words:
 
 
• Leader: a head of a group or organization.
 
• Fugitive: escaper, a person who has escaped.
 
• Criminal: one who has committed a crime.
